The second line mentions mercy towards children and respect for the elderly, which are themes of kindness and social values.

This is contrasting the weakness of disciples with the strength of masters, possibly in a spiritual or mentor context. Themes of strength vs. weakness, guidance.

Option 4: "به چشم حرمت و تعظیم در پیر - نگه کن درهمه کاین هست توقیر (گرامی داشتن)."
